premises.text: Dynamic pricing and complex price-drop guarantees leave consumers unable to reclaim money they are owed
premises.evidence_span: it takes a ton of time to price compare, figure out if you're owed money back, and ultimately engage back and forth with customer service to get paid. Nobody does it

premises.text: Paribus automatically scans receipts, tracks price drops, checks store policies, and files refund claims for shoppers
premises.evidence_span: It scans your inbox for receipts, tracks the prices on what you bought, and when they drop, automatically files claims to get you paid

premises.text: Security design pulls only receipt/store mail via subject/sender webhooks and protects retained data with strong controls
premises.evidence_span: We placed customized webhooks to pull receipts and store communications based on subject and sender alone, without ever touching the contents of your other emails

premises.text: Paribus takes 25% of savings after the user is paid, reducible to zero via referrals, across major online stores
premises.evidence_span: Our standard fee is charged 25% of the money we earn you. If you share it with your friends, you can bring this down to zero

value.text: Consumers effortlessly recover money owed from post-purchase price drops
value.evidence_span: Paribus is a web app that gets you the money you're owed effortlessly

causal_links.evidence_span: online consumers are leaving $10 billion on the table every year
The only time that Paribus earns is after we save you money first

notes: Amazon price-change stats and guarantee hassle folded as one consumer refund-friction pain (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). OAuth inbox, account linking, scraping/coupons/NLP claims folded as cascade of auto-claim product (§4.1.7); security kept as separately emphasized trust condition. Beta savings counts excluded as traction. Anti-template: problem, product/security, and fee model separately revisable.
